reconcile.note: Fausset treats Maachah and Michaiah as one queen mother renamed at accession, resolving the two fathers via Tamar's marriage to Uriel, making Absalom her grandfather.

sides.snippet: his mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom
sides.verseText: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

sides.snippet: his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah
sides.verseText: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
